fixes.explanation: Jesus doesn't talk about growing old here, friend. He says eternal life is “…that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” It's about knowing God and Jesus Christ. Nobody is handing out a number to live up to in verse 3.

Jesus asks the Father, “…glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.” Look at that word "had." He isn't asking for something brand new, friend. He's asking to be back in the Father's presence with the glory that was already His, like a stamper asking for his own spot on the counter.
